articles.title: Mumbai–Pune in 48 minutes, Chennai–Bengaluru in 73: India’s 7 new proposed bullet train corridors explained
articles.summary: India plans 7 new bullet train corridors covering ~4,000 km — Mumbai–Pune in 48 min, Chennai–Bengaluru in 73 min. NHSRCL will use one standard design for all routes to cut costs and speed up construction.

articles.title: Air India AI-171 crash: 'No abnormality found in fuel switch,' says Aviation Ministry
articles.summary: He said a detailed examination of the switch, including the structural integrity of its locking detents, found no abnormality, though inspection of the complete thrust control module is still under way at the OEM facility.

articles.title: Samsung Q2 results: Tech giant posts record high $62 billion profit on AI chip boom
articles.summary: Samsung Electronics achieved its highest-ever quarterly operating profit, fueled by strong AI chip demand. Rival SK Hynix also reported record revenue, reflecting industry strength. However, investor sentiment declined due to expansion plans and Chinese competition.

articles.title: Asian stocks trade mixed after Fed holds rates; Kospi rallies 4%, Shenzhen slips 300 points
articles.summary: Asian equities showed signs of stabilizing on Thursday after a turbulent week. Taiwan and South Korea saw gains, while Japan's Nikkei headed for a decline. Oil prices briefly soared due to Middle East tensions before slipping back below $90.

articles.title: These two countries consume 70% of the world’s coal…and it’s who you think it is
articles.summary: The rise in global consumption in 2025 was mainly driven by rapidly industrialising economies in Southeast Asia, while the United States also saw a reversal in coal use during the year.

articles.title: Mahindra arm, SML combine to be 4th largest CV player
articles.summary: Mahindra Group aims for substantial market share growth in India's commercial vehicle sector. The company targets a 10-12% share of the heavy commercial vehicle market by FY31. It also seeks over 20% market share by FY36 after business consolidation.

articles.title: 'GenAI to reshape workforce, GCCs to cushion job impact'
articles.summary: GenAI will transform India's labor market over the next decade. Tasks will be automated, and many jobs will be augmented by AI. The technology sector's employment narrative is challenged by this evolving landscape.

articles.title: IPL's business value crosses $20 billion, RCB top brand: Report
articles.summary: Indian Premier League's business value reached $20.6 billion in 2026, showing significant growth. Royal Challengers Bengaluru's brand value crossed $300 million, marking a historic milestone. Mumbai Indians also saw its brand value increase, securing the second position.

articles.title: Smartphone exports rise 23% to $9.8 billion in Q1
Crude prices retreat as oil continues flowing through Hormuz alternatives
articles.summary: Oil prices declined on Thursday after a significant rally the previous day. Crude oil continued to move out of the Middle East despite escalating conflict. Shipping activity indicated that oil supplies were still finding routes out of the region.

articles.title: Exporters flag concerns over West Asia war impact
articles.summary: Exporters face order uncertainty and higher logistics costs due to the West Asia crisis. Shipping schedules are delayed, and buyers are delaying purchase decisions. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal met with export promotion bodies to discuss these issues.

articles.title: Gold loans rise on larger ticket sizes, unsecured credit shift
articles.summary: Gold loans are experiencing significant growth, driven by existing borrowers taking larger amounts. This surge also reflects a shift from unsecured personal loans to secured gold financing options. Gold loans now represent a substantial portion of total consumer credit in India.

articles.title: ₹5 lakh to ₹20 lakh tickets: Why Maharajas’ Express is considered India’s ultimate luxury train experience
articles.summary: Maharajas’ Express offers India’s ultimate luxury train journey with royal suites, fine dining, heritage tours and ticket prices ranging from ₹5 lakh to over ₹20 lakh per person.

articles.title: Quote of the Day by Azim Premji: ‘You cannot have a society where you spend more than you earn. I mean, it's just fundamentally not viable in the long run’
articles.summary: Often referred to as the "Czar of the Indian IT Industry," he is best known for transforming Wipro Limited from a small family-run cooking oil business into a multi-billion-dollar global software and outsourcing giant.

articles.title: Banks collected Rs 7,100 crore as ‘minimum balance’ penalty in 2025-26
articles.summary: Banks collected nearly Rs 7,100 crore in minimum balance penalties during FY26. Private banks gathered Rs 4,948 crore, a significant increase from the previous year. HDFC Bank alone levied Rs 1,800 crore in charges from its customers.

articles.title: E20 petrol may harm BS-III vehicle rubber parts, says Nitin Gadkari
articles.summary: Road transport minister Nitin Gadkari informed Rajya Sabha about E20 fuel impacts. Studies found no major performance impact on overall vehicle operations. BS-VI vehicles continue meeting emission norms when tested with E20 fuel.

articles.title: Companies boost health cover with top-ups for cancer
articles.summary: Companies are enhancing employee health benefits beyond standard medical insurance. AstraZeneca Pharma India leads by introducing a group cancer care policy. This new coverage supplements existing plans and addresses high treatment costs.

articles.title: Need to reinvent ways to deal with global challenges: Finance ministry
articles.summary: India's economy shows resilience despite global challenges and uncertainties. Swift policy responses and implementation are crucial for attracting investment. Rising crude oil prices pose a potential pressure on fiscal and current accounts.

articles.title: Stuck at Sarai Kale Khan every day? NHAI begins work on a plan that could cut your travel time
articles.summary: With the DND-Sohna corridor set to bring even more traffic into the already choked Sarai Kale Khan loop, NHAI is racing to find a long-term fix before the bottleneck gets worse.

articles.title: US Federal Reserve meet today: Kevin Warsh-led FOMC keeps interest rates unchanged
articles.summary: The US Federal Reserve, which began its two-day policy meeting on Tuesday, was widely expected to leave its benchmark interest rate unchanged.

articles.title: India-US trade pact: Piyush Goyal explains the one condition to seal the deal
articles.summary: India's trade pact with the US awaits tariff competitiveness restoration for its first phase. Minister Piyush Goyal stated India needs a comparative advantage over rival nations. This condition must be met before the bilateral trade agreement can commence.

articles.title: What India needs to do to respond to emerging global challenges, high crude oil prices: Finance Ministry outlines
articles.summary: The report stressed that deeper domestic reforms and quicker policy execution will be essential to alter the country's long-term economic trajectory.

articles.title: Oil prices jump over 7% as Middle East chaos flares up, brent crude back at $90 per barrel
articles.summary: Oil prices surged over seven percent on Wednesday amid renewed Middle East military actions. This rally was also supported by industry data showing a drawdown in US crude inventories. Renewed strikes involving the United States and Iran-backed groups reignited supply concerns.

articles.title: US stock market today: Wall Street in red ahead of US Federal Reserve policy review; oil prices climb
articles.summary: Markets are currently assigning about a 36% probability to a US rate hike, which, if delivered, would mark the first increase in three years. While higher interest rates help curb inflation, they can also dampen economic activity and weigh on equity valuations.

articles.title: Semicon 2.0, space, hydrogen trains: How manufacturing push is gaining pace, shows July's economic review
articles.summary: The Department of Economic Affairs' Monthly Economic Review for July 2026 noted that while geopolitical tensions in West Asia, elevated commodity prices and global supply-chain risks continue to cloud the economic outlook, India's manufacturing sector has main…

articles.title: India faces 100% Trump tariff threat as US Senate advances Russia Sanctions Bill - what it means
articles.summary: India has stepped up Russian crude oil purchases to make up for the deficit, helped in part by the US sanctions waiver which lapsed recently. However, India has continued to procure Russian crude.

articles.title: India's NH toll network expands 65% in five years; Rajasthan leads
articles.summary: The government also informed Parliament that it has temporarily discontinued toll collection at seven National Highway fee plazas across Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat, Himachal Pradesh, Jharkhand, Karnataka and Kerala.

articles.title: ₹8,862 crore in tolls! This state emerged as India's biggest highway toll revenue generator
articles.summary: Overall, toll collections on National Highways and Expressways continued to grow, rising from ₹61,408.15 crore in 2024-25 to ₹68,483 crore in user fee collections during 2025-26

articles.title: To stay ahead, Indian manufacturers are embracing AI
articles.summary: PwC India study finds 59% of manufacturers expect AI to drive strategic growth over the next five years, with automation set to transform factories from the shop floor to customer service

articles.title: Indian-origin CEO Shailesh Jejurikar appointed Chairman of P&G Board
articles.summary: Jejurikar succeeds Jon Moeller, who will retire from the Board on July 31 and from the company on August 14

articles.title: ITR filing deadline nears: How to file income tax return online on e-filing portal - quick 15-step guide
articles.summary: The process to file the income tax return has evolved over the last few years and the income tax portal now pre-fills a lot of your tax related information drawing from information in documents such as Form 16, Form 26AS, Annual Information Statement (AIS), bank records etc.

articles.title: No more Kumbh traffic woes! Prayagraj's new 9.8-km Ganga bridge is opening in November — and it could change the city forever
articles.summary: Prayagraj's new ₹1,947-crore, 9.8-km, six-lane Ganga bridge — UP's longest cantilever structure — is 94% complete and set to open for vehicular traffic in November 2026.

articles.title: Once abandoned, now reborn: Andhra's iconic Havelock Bridge is set to become a must-visit spot
articles.summary: The century-old Havelock Bridge, once destined for the scrapyard, is now set for a dramatic revival as the state sanctions Rs 47 Crore for Havelock Bridge revamp.

articles.title: 1854 to today: The mountain school where history meets global education
articles.summary: Founded in 1854, Woodstock School in Mussoorie is one of India’s oldest international boarding schools, known for its Himalayan campus, heritage architecture and global education.

articles.title: Batwara 1947 trailer: Sunny Deol, A.R. Rahman and the partition drama that could be the film of the year
articles.summary: Sunny Deol and Rajkumar Santoshi reunite in Batwara 1947 — a Partition drama backed by Aamir Khan Productions, with A.R. Rahman's music, releasing August 14, 2026. Trailer is out now.

articles.title: No designer, no drama: Saumya Tandon’s self-designed home leaves fans amazed
articles.summary: TV actress Saumya Tandon’s Mumbai home reflects her personal style with vintage European interiors, pastel shades, classic furniture and artistic corners designed without a professional decorator.

articles.title: TVS’ big move for kids: This mini bike could create India’s next racing stars
articles.summary: TVS Racing’s Apache RR 200 Mini brings professional-style racing to young riders aged 10-14. With a 197.75cc engine and track-focused setup, it aims to create India’s future racers.

articles.title: Machine failed, business suffered: Kerala entrepreneur wins ₹75,000 after three-year battle over ₹25 lakh equipment
articles.summary: The entrepreneur said the company had promised that the machine could fill 1,000 litres of concentrate every hour, helping her reduce her workforce by five employees.

articles.summary: iPhone 18 Pro leaks point to a 2nm A20 Pro chip, 5,500 mAh battery, 35% smaller Dynamic Island, Dark Cherry colour and manual camera aperture — starting at ₹1,39,900 in India.

articles.title: 52 extra trips announced: Namo Bharat’s big move to handle Kanwar Yatra passenger rush
articles.summary: Namo Bharat adds 52 extra daily trips on the Delhi-Meerut corridor ahead of Kanwar Yatra rush. Trains will run every 8 minutes to ease travel for commuters and pilgrims.
